thread:
mira: rolling a soft launch tonight for model-routing v3. Target quiet-window 01:30-03:30 UTC. Feature flag: llmroute_v3_gate. Plan is conservative ramping with a short initial pin.

raj: propose pin to v2 for 90s then allow a 0.5% cohort, then 5%, 25%, 100% over 20m steps. Keep manual step at 25% so we can validate batching behaviour.

mira: agreed. command i'll use below. also want telemetry keys surfaced so Optimize can chart batch_size and cache_hit_ratio.

mira: ```/deploybot start --service llmroute --image v3.1-rc --ff llmroute_v3_gate --ramp 0,0.5,5,25,100 --step-duration 1200 --initial-pin 90 --manual-at 25 --notify eng-releases```

deploybot: Accepted. I will pin traffic to v2 for 90s, then perform the ramp. Health gates: global_5xx_rate, p95_latency, embedding_tail_ratio. Auto-pause thresholds set.

lia: what's the exact auto-rollback policy? need clear numbers for oncall.

mira: auto-rollback if absolute global_5xx_rate increases by >=0.8 percentage points for 10m OR p95 latency worsens by >=30% for any 7m window OR embedding_tail_ratio >0.4% for 5m. On rollback: drain new pods, pin to v2, notify oncall, attach logs.

raj: add an infra soft-hold: if scale-up queue length > 200 for any 3m then pause and notify infra channel; do not rollback automatically.

mira: added soft-hold. Also applying a 6m alert mute for minor alerts during each step to reduce signal noise; severity=critical still fires.

carmen: cs wants a privacy-safe list of accounts in the 0.5% cohort. i'll generate an obfuscated id list and drop to #ops-sec after deploy starts.

mira: thanks. i'll include a short internal release note too.

mira: "Internal note: v3.1-rc of llmroute consolidates route tables and improves cache locality. Expected median latency improvement 7-11%. Controlled rollout behind llmroute_v3_gate. See runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/llmroute-v3-rollout"

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: quiet-window 2026-03-24 01:30-03:30 UTC.

deploybot: Event: deploy queued (8165000060). Pin active (90s).

deploybot: Event: pin expired, ramp to 0.5% (8165000155). Health check window open.

lia: monitoring tail latencies. charts look stable so far.

deploybot: Event: ramp to 5% (8165001355). Gate check: p95 within expected, global_5xx_rate flat.

raj: holding at 25% manual step after next increase. please don't auto-advance past 25%.

deploybot: Event: ramp to 25% (8165002555) -> halted at manual step (8165002560). Awaiting manual approval to continue.

mira: inspecting traces, cache_hit_ratio trending up, batch_size steady. approve continue to 100% in 10m unless anomalies.

deploybot: Event: ramp to 100% (8165003600). All gates passed. Final state: llmroute_v3_gate at 100% (manual cutover completed). Rollout logs: https://internal.redwood/infralog/8165000000

lia: will compile a post-rollout perf summary in ~3h. if we see embedding-tail regressions i'll open a rollback thread.

carmen: cs note drafted and posted to stakeholders.

mira: closing thread; follow-up doc will include perf deltas, cohort export, and any noted anomalies. thanks everyone.
